summary: SciSparc Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its receipt of a conditional compliance letter from Nasdaq regarding continued listing requirements. On January 12, 2026, the company was notified of non-compliance with Rule 5550(b) due to insufficient stockholders' equity. On May 7, 2026, Nasdaq determined compliance based on the 2025 Form 20-F but warned that failure to provide evidence in the next periodic report could lead to delisting. This is a routine listing compliance update, not a special situation.
